content.value_statement: Teams lose trust when blockers are vague or hidden. This skill turns failures, fixes, and health metrics into clear reports.
actual_capabilities: Creates structured blocker reports with failure details, impact, root cause, attempted fixes, and current state.
Documents resolved blockers with fix details, verification steps, risk assessment, and lessons learned.
Generates periodic health reports covering active blockers, recent solutions, build health, quality metrics, and velocity.
Formats stakeholder updates that separate completed work, blocked work, active work, metrics, and next plans.
Defines severity levels so teams can classify blockers as critical, high, medium, or low.
Tracks patterns such as resolution time, recurrence, root cause distribution, and impact on velocity.
limitations: It depends on accurate project facts supplied by the user or surrounding workflow.
It does not run tests, builds, deployments, or diagnostics by itself.
It does not automatically publish reports to issue trackers, chat tools, or document systems.
It documents blockers and fixes, but it does not resolve the underlying technical issue.

use_cases.title: Blocker Log for Engineering Leads
use_cases.description: Record a production, build, or feature blocker with impact, owner, target resolution, and attempted solutions.

use_cases.title: Fix Summary for Developers
use_cases.description: Document the exact fix, why it works, verification completed, and lessons that reduce future recurrence.

use_cases.title: Status Report for Stakeholders
use_cases.description: Create a plain-language update that shows completed work, blocked work, health metrics, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Log a New Blocker
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: capture one blocker in the standard format.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use transparency-reporter to create a blocker report. Feature: [feature]. Expected: [expected]. Actual: [actual]. Error: [error]. Impact: [impact].

prompt_templates.title: Document a Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: record how a blocker was resolved.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use transparency-reporter to write a solution report for blocker [id]. Include changed files, why the fix works, verification, risks, and lessons learned.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Health Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: summarize project health over a reporting period.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use transparency-reporter to create a system health report for [date range]. Include blockers, recent solutions, build health, quality metrics, velocity, and trends.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Recurring Blockers
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: turn multiple blocker records into prevention guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use transparency-reporter to review these blocker notes: [notes]. Identify repeated root causes, systemic risks, prevention steps, owners, and next actions.

output_examples.input: A deployment is blocked because production builds fail during manifest generation.
output_examples.output: A blocker report lists the failure, affected deployment, current owner, attempted fixes, root cause confidence, and target resolution.

output_examples.input: A build issue was fixed by creating a required directory before the build step.
output_examples.output: A solution report explains the change, why it works, verification performed, remaining risk, and the lesson for future builds.

output_examples.input: The team needs a weekly project health summary for stakeholders.
output_examples.output: A status update separates completed work, blocked items, in-progress work, metrics, next plan, and dependencies.

best_practices: Provide exact symptoms, errors, owners, and dates so the report is traceable.
Separate facts from analysis when describing impact and root cause.
Update the report whenever blocker state, risk, or target resolution changes.
anti_patterns: Do not report vague progress when the work is still blocked.
Do not omit failed attempts, because they prevent repeated work.
Do not hide recurring issues that may show a systemic problem.

faq.question: What does transparency-reporter create?
faq.answer: It creates blocker reports, solution reports, health reports, and stakeholder updates.

faq.question: Does it investigate technical failures?
faq.answer: No. It records findings and status after diagnostics are provided by users or other agents.

faq.question: Can it help with incident communication?
faq.answer: Yes. It organizes facts, impact, ownership, current status, and next steps for clear communication.

faq.question: Does it store reports automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends report locations, but storage depends on the active workspace workflow.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the failure, expected behavior, actual behavior, impact, owner, attempted fixes, and current status.
